error[ZBX-E1002]: the virtual machine did not start
  while  validating the virtual machine's configuration
  cause  Virtualization.framework said: Invalid virtual machine configuration.
         (VZErrorDomain 1)
  log    /Users/ada/Library/Application Support/zbx/vm/console.log
  fix    read how far the guest got:   tail -n 20 '/Users/ada/Library/Application Support/zbx/vm/console.log'
         or try a smaller size:        zbx vm config --memory 1G
  more   zbx explain E1002
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1002.html
